generate_text_rule.binding_rule: provider, model, request digest, adapter identity, adapter version, and certification identity must match across the signed Permit facts and certified-boundary evidence.

refund_rule.binding_rule: the original-payment, payer, reason, amount, currency, rail, exact-request, idempotency, expiry, and one-use facts must remain signed and internally consistent; dispatch and use are adjudicated by separate universal claims.
refund_rule.claim_ceiling: The claim proves the exact authorization relationship; processor acceptance and funds returned require separate provider evidence.
